subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before merging this session-state timing change?
rationale: ClawSweeper can verify the source-level timing path, but it cannot prove the reported user-visible Feishu race is fixed from synthetic helper tests alone.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry.

options.title: Accept source-only timing risk
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally merge based on source and focused test evidence, while owning that the reported transport path was not proven here.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 until someone can produce transport or production-runner proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result persists without a synthetic missing-result entry.

likelyOwner.reason: History ties this person to the session guard and recent wait-for-idle maintenance, making them the best available owner for proof sufficiency.
